Name: Animated NPC Furniture Generator
Author: Syuchinikurin
Description:
This tool automatically generates FurnitureFramework3.0 content.json files based on character sprite sheets and a simple text configuration.

I've pre-written animation configurations for most Stardew Valley characters , may include configs for mods like SVE and RSV in future updates. If you have any suggestions, feature requests, or bug reports, feel free to let me know.

根据行走图为动画家具生成 FurnitureFramework3.0 所需的 content.json 文件。

已经包含了原版角色的动画数据，闲了会写大型mod的。有问题请告诉我。

Downloads.Description:
Requirements:
- Python 3.6 or higher
- PIL/Pillow library for image processing
